CTYPE html>
<html lang="vi" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
					<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1">
<title>Phần mềm Kiểm tra Lý thuyết Điều lệnh CAND</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#F3F5F1;
    --surface:#FFFFFF;
    --surface-2:#EAEDE7;
    --ink:#14241C;
    --muted:#5B6B62;
    --border:#DDE3DA;
    --primary:#0F3D2E;
    --primary-2:#1C6B4A;
    --primary-soft:#E4EEE7;
    --gold:#B8912A;
    --gold-soft:#F6EDD3;
    --red:#B3261E;
    --red-soft:#FBE6E4;
    --green:#1E7B4D;
    --green-soft:#E3F2E8;
    --shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(15,61,46,0.08);
    --radius:14px;
    --font-display:"Arial Narrow","Segoe UI Semibold","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;
    --font-body:"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#0D1712;
    --surface:#152420;
    --surface-2:#1B2C26;
    --ink:#E8EFE9;
    --muted:#93A69C;
    --border:#25392F;
    --primary:#3FA377;
    --primary-2:#2E7D57;
    --primary-soft:#17352A;
    --gold:#D9B44C;
    --gold-soft:#33301A;
    --red:#E5766D;
    --red-soft:#3A1E1C;
    --green:#5FCB92;
    --green-soft:#1B3327;
    --shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--font-body);
    min-height:100vh;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .app{max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 16px 60px;}
  .topbar{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:10px 2px 18px;
  }
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .seal{
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--surface);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--border);
    flex:none;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .seal
  i width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
  .print-watermark{
    display:none;
  }
  @media print{
    .print-watermark{
      display:block;position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:60%;opacity:0.08;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
    }
    #printArea{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  }
  .brand-text .t0{
    font-family:var(--font-display);
    font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.8px;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:11px;color:var(--primary);margin-bottom:1px;
  }
  .brand-text .t1{
    font-family:var(--font-display);
    font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
  }
  .brand-text .t2{
    font-family:var(--font-display);
    font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:0.5px;
    color:var(--primary);
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .brand-text .t2{color:var(--primary);}
  .icon-btn{
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;width:38px;height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-size:16px;
  }
  .icon-btn:active{transform:scale(0.94);}
  .screen{display:none;}
  .screen.active{display:block;animation:fade .25s ease;}
  @keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

  .card{
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    padding:22px;margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-display);letter-spacing:0.3px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--ink);}
  h2{font-size:20px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--primary);}
  [data-theme="dark"] h2{color:var(--primary);}
  p.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;}
  label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 6px;}
  input[type=text],input[type=number],textarea,select{
    width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-family:var(--font-body);
  }
  textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
    background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;
    padding:12px 20px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--font-body);
  }
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);}
  .btn.secondary{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .btn.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#2b2200;}
  .btn.danger{background:var(--red);color:#fff;}
  .btn.block{width:100%;}
  .btn:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .row>*{flex:1;min-width:130px;}
  .chip-group{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;}
  .chip{
    padding:9px 16px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surface-2);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);
  }
  .chip.active{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-color:var(--primary);}
  .menu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;}
  .menu-item{
    background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;
    padding:14px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);
  }
  .menu-item .ic{font-size:20px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .menu-item:active{transform:scale(0.97);}
  .footer-credit{
    text-align:center;color:var(--muted);opacity:0.65;font-size:10.5px;margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:0.2px;
  }
  .card + .footer-credit{
    margin-top:26px;
  }

  /* QUIZ SCREEN */
  .quiz-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;gap:10px;}
  .progress-wrap{flex:1;}
  .progress-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;}
  .progress-bar{height:8px;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;}
  .progress-fill{height:100%;background:var(--primary-2);border-radius:6px;transition:width .3s;}
  .timer{
    font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;background:var(--surface-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink);
  }
  .timer.warn{background:var(--red-soft);color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);}

  .qnav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(38px,1fr));gap:6px;margin:14px 0 18px;}
  .qnav button{
    height:38px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);
    color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;
  }
  .qnav button.answered{background:var(--primary-soft);border-color:var(--primary-2);color:var(--primary-2);}
  .qnav button.current{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-color:var(--primary);}
  [data-theme="dark"] .qnav button.answered{color:var(--primary);}

  .q-badge{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;
    border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:0.5px;
  }
  .q-text{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .opt{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;
    transition:border-color .15s, background .15s;
  }
  .opt .mark{
    width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--muted);flex:none;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
  }
  .opt.selected{border-color:var(--primary-2);background:var(--primary-soft);}
  .opt.selected .mark{background:var(--primary-2);border-color:var(--primary-2);color:#fff;}
  .opt.correct{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-soft);}
  .opt.correct .mark{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff;}
  .opt.wrong{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-soft);}
  .opt.wrong .mark{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff;}

  .quiz-actions{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;}

  /* RESULT */
  .stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin:16px 0;}
  .stat-box{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;text-align:center;}
  .stat-box .val{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);}
  [data-theme="dark"] .stat-box .val{color:var(--primary);}
  .stat-box .lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
  .score-hero{
    text-align:center;padding:20px 0 6px;
  }
  .score-hero .big{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:48px;font-weight:800;color:var(--primary);}
  .score-hero .pct{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
  .review-item{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px 0;}
  .review-item .qnum{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;}
  .review-opt{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;margin-top:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .review-opt.correct{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);font-weight:600;}
  .review-opt.wrong{background:var(--red-soft);border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);font-weight:600;}

  /* TABLE */
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;}
  th,td{padding:9px 8px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  th{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;}
  tr.me{background:var(--primary-soft);}

  .bank-item{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:12px 0;}
  .bank-item .qq{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .bank-item .oo{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0;}
  .bank-item .oo.correct{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;}
  .badge-sample{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:12px;}

  .warn-banner{
    background:var(--gold-soft);border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);
    border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.5;
  }
  .back-link{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:12px;}

  @media (max-width:480px){
    .menu-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .score-hero .big{font-size:38px;}
  }

  @media print{
    body *{visibility:hidden;}
    #printArea, #printArea *{visibility:visible;}
    #printArea{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">

  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">
       <div class="seal"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Huy hiệu CAND"></div>
			<div class="brand-text">
        <div class="t0">Công an tỉnh Thái Nguyên</div>
        <div class="t1">Ôn tập &amp; kiểm tra</div>
        <div class="t2">Lý thuyết Điều lệnh CAND</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="icon-btn" id="themeToggle" title="Đổi giao diện sáng/tối">🌙</button>
  </div>

  <!-- LOGIN -->
  <div class="screen active" id="screen-login">
    <div class="card">      <h2 style="text-align:center">Đăng nhập</h2>
      <p class="sub">Nhập tên để lưu kết quả và tham gia xếp hạng.</p>
      <label>Họ và tên người thi</label>
      <input type="text" id="loginName" placeholder="VD: Nguyễn Văn A" maxlength="60">
      <button class="btn block" style="margin-top:18px" onclick="doLogin()">Vào kiểm tra</button>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-credit">Chỉ đạo nội dung: đ/c Thiếu tá Lương Văn Thiều – Trưởng CAX Bình Yên</div>
    <div class="footer-credit">Xây dựng phần mềm: đ/c Phạm Đức Toàn – Cán bộ CAX Bình Yên</div>
  </div>

  <!-- HOME / SETUP -->
  <div class="screen" id="screen-setup">
    <div class="card">
      <h2 id="greetName">Xin chào</h2>
      <p class="sub">Thiết lập bài kiểm tra trước khi bắt đầu.</p>

      <label>Số câu hỏi</label>
      <div class="chip-group" id="numChips"></div>

      <label>Thời gian làm bài (phút)</label>
      <input type="number" id="timeMinutes" min="1" max="180" value="20">

      <button class="btn block gold" style="margin-top:20px" onclick="startExam()">▶ Bắt đầu làm bài</button>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <h2 style="font-size:15px">Chức năng khác</h2>
      <div class="menu-grid">
        <div class="menu-item" onclick="openBank()"><span class="ic">🔍</span>Ngân hàng câu hỏi</div>
        <div class="menu-item" onclick="openHistory()"><span class="ic">🏆</span>Lịch sử &amp; Xếp hạng</div>
        <div class="menu-item" onclick="openImport()"><span class="ic">💾</span>Nhập câu hỏi</div>
        <div class="menu-item" onclick="doLogout()"><span class="ic">🔚</span>Đăng xuất</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-credit">CAX Bình Yên, 2026</div>
  </div>

  <!-- QUIZ -->
  <div class="screen" id="screen-quiz">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="quiz-head">
        <div class="progress-wrap">
          <div class="progress-label"><span id="progLabel">0/0 đã trả lời</span><span id="progPct">0%</span></div>
          <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" id="progFill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="timer" id="timerBox">20:00</div>
      </div>

      <div class="qnav" id="qnav"></div>

      <div class="q-badge" id="qBadge">Câu 1/20</div>
      <div class="q-text" id="qText">...</div>
      <div class="options" id="qOptions"></div>

      <div class="quiz-actions">
        <button class="btn secondary" id="btnPrev" onclick="prevQ()">← Câu trước</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" id="btnNext" onclick="nextQ()">Câu sau →</button>
      </div>
      <button class="btn block danger" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="trySubmit()">✅ Nộp bài</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RESULT -->
  <div class="screen" id="screen-result">
    <div id="printArea">
    <img class="print-watermark" src="data:image/png;base64,
